nodes.description: Mapping from string key to a packed uint256 (value << 128 | timestamp) holding feed values.
Address authorized to write oracle values and to rotate the updater address; single privileged role.
Constructor that assigns msg.sender to oracleUpdater, establishing the initial privileged account.
Access-controlled writer that packs uint128 value and uint128 timestamp into a uint256 and stores it in values[key].
Public view function that unpacks values[key] into (value, timestamp).
Access-controlled function that transfers the oracleUpdater role to a new address.
msg.sender read in the constructor to initialize oracleUpdater.
msg.sender checked against oracleUpdater inside setValue.
msg.sender checked against oracleUpdater inside updateOracleUpdaterAddress.
Arithmetic packing: uint256(value) << 128 + timestamp creating the stored composite integer.
Arithmetic unpacking: cValue % 2**128 for timestamp and cValue >> 128 for value.
key parameter of setValue selecting the mapping slot.
value parameter (uint128) packed into the high 128 bits.
timestamp parameter (uint128) packed into the low 128 bits.
key parameter of getValue used to read the stored value.
new privileged updater address supplied to updateOracleUpdaterAddress.
Local cValue holding the packed value/timestamp integer in setValue.
Local cValue reading values[key] in getValue.
Local unpacked timestamp returned by getValue.
Local unpacked value returned by getValue.

edges.reason: Constructor writes msg.sender into the privileged oracleUpdater state variable, so caller identity becomes the sole authorized account.
Deployment-time msg.sender determines the privileged configuration performed by the constructor body.
constructor initializes the oracleUpdater state variable.
require(msg.sender == oracleUpdater) gates execution of setValue on caller identity.
msg.sender in setValue is compared against the oracleUpdater state variable.
oracleUpdater state is read inside the setValue authorization guard.
require(msg.sender == oracleUpdater) gates execution of updateOracleUpdaterAddress.
msg.sender in updateOracleUpdaterAddress is compared against oracleUpdater.
oracleUpdater state is read and later overwritten inside updateOracleUpdaterAddress.
new updater parameter flows into the privileged function updateOracleUpdaterAddress.
new updater parameter is assigned to oracleUpdater, transferring the privileged role.
updateOracleUpdaterAddress writes the oracleUpdater state variable.
key parameter flows into the setValue function body.
key parameter selects the mapping entry written in values.
value parameter is left-shifted into the packed uint256.
timestamp parameter is added into the packed uint256.
packing result is stored in local cValue in setValue.
packed cValue is written into values[key].
setValue writes contract state through the values mapping.
key parameter flows into the getValue function body.
getValue reads the values mapping state variable.
stored packed integer is read from values into local cValue in getValue.
packed value is fed into the modulo and shift unpacking operation.
unpacked timestamp is assigned to the local timestamp variable in getValue.
unpacked value is assigned to the local value variable in getValue.

normalization_plan.reason: setValue.key is a parameter used only inside setValue and should be normalized into the setValue function node.
setValue.value is consumed directly by the arithmetic packing operation and should be merged into that unsafe operation node.
setValue.timestamp is consumed directly by the arithmetic packing operation and should be merged into that unsafe operation node.
getValue.key is a parameter used only inside getValue and should be normalized into the getValue function node.
newOracleUpdaterAddress is a parameter used only inside updateOracleUpdaterAddress and should be normalized into that function node.
local cValue in setValue holds the result of the packing arithmetic and should be merged into the packing unsafe operation node.
local cValue in getValue is a temporary read buffer and should be merged into the getValue function node.
local timestamp in getValue is produced by the unpacking arithmetic and should be merged into that unsafe operation node.
local value in getValue is produced by the unpacking arithmetic and should be merged into that unsafe operation node.
